question: What height measurements define the lotus-seat rise at the root of the pillar?
premises: The lotus-seat rise is located at the root.
One possible measure is one staff.
Another possible measure is one and a half or two staffs.
inference: The rise of the lotus seat at the root may measure one staff or one and a half to two staffs.
uncertainties: The exact parsing of sārdhadvidaṇḍaṃ as a combined measure is interpretive.
plain_english: At the root, the rise of the lotus seat should be one staff or one and a half to two staffs.
